subject: math
topicName: Geometry - Lesson 5: Composite Figures with Circles
description: Learn how to separate composite figures into rectangles, triangles, circles, and semicircles, then find total area by adding the parts.
learningObjectives: Identify rectangles, triangles, circles, and semicircles inside composite figures
Decompose a composite figure into non-overlapping parts
Choose the correct area formula for each part
Find total area by adding the areas of all parts
Check whether an answer uses square units and a reasonable plan
